resources.description: No standing territory-specific lawyer-assistance program located; resolves to the national safety net (988, SAMHSA, ABA CoLAP). The Colegio de Abogados y Abogadas de Puerto Rico has emerging wellbeing initiatives (a 2025 wellness event, nascent commissions) but no dedicated program with counseling/hotline services.

resources.name: Alternative Disciplinary and Attorney Wellness Committee
resources.confidential: Not stated on the bylaws page
resources.description: Standing committee of the Guam Bar Association (added 2024) that manages Rule 11 disability referrals and promotes attorney well-being through education, peer-to-peer support, and resources in mental health, emotional balance, stress management, and addiction. No dedicated hotline is published; access is via the bar.
